collection.name: fan-out-documents
collection.description: Per-document processing endpoints for the fan-out (TaskType 21) scenario. The default route succeeds; document ids starting with DOC-FAIL fail deterministically so the partial-failure leg is exercised without timing games, and ids starting with DOC-SLOW are routed by the mapping to a delayed route so the load test's straggler ratio measures something real instead of jitter.

mocks.description: Processes one document. The fan-out mapping's ItemInputHandler appends ?documentId=<FanOutItem.ItemKey> to this route, which is how each parallel item is told which document it owns — an HttpTask's URL lives on the cloned task, not on the branch body, so the zero-script path could not do this.

Deliberate straggler. A fan-out batch's wall clock is dominated by its single slowest item, so the load test needs one item that is reliably slow rather than hoping for jitter. delayMs is a mock-level field — it cannot be expressed on a rule — which is why this is a separate route the mapping selects for DOC-SLOW ids.
